purpose: Historical generation prompts for the six approved reference images; not runtime assets.

prompts.name: 01 潮汐长滩
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE standalone panoramic 3:1 concept for a 2D side-scrolling artillery game. Reference image is ONLY for realistic material quality, large sky proportion, shallow underground crop and single side-on profile; DO NOT copy its snow or two-peak composition unless requested. Strict FLAT TWO DIMENSIONAL SIDE ELEVATION: single-valued terrain height y=f(x), one crisp upper collision contour, solid vertical cross-section below, air above. Tanks move LEFT/RIGHT along this contour only, climbing over peaks, not along a second path across a mountain's face. No isometric angle, no visible top planes, no foreground/background sharp overlapping ridges, no receding roads. Realistic finely detailed natural textures on the flat side-section, NOT flat color cartoons. All distant scenery extremely blurred, desaturated and low contrast. Clear distinction between blurry background and crisp physical terrain. 65-70% image area open sky and air; low ground at 85-90% down, major tops can reach 45-60% down, very little underground below valleys. Natural dramatic asymmetry with broad climbable slopes; comparable opportunities on both sides but never mirrored. Two tiny orange/teal side-view tanks at outer ends, same approximate starting elevation. Water bodies specified below are WIDE HORIZONTAL FOREGROUND SEGMENTS, not tiny puddles and NOT background lakes. Shallows drawn as thin transparent water cap over traversable nearly level bed, long and shallow. No text, labels, UI, arrows, collage.
NO SNOW, NO ICE. Gold sand beach + long shallow tidal flats + rocky foothill + silver gravel. Left-to-right sequence: golden rolling shore 0-12%; LONG shallow cyan water flat x12-31%; a big broad climbable weathered grey limestone hill x31-48%; gravel slope x48-53%; SECOND LONGER extremely shallow turquoise flat x53-78%; unequal rolling sand dunes and low rocky shore x78-100%. Two water stretches cover 44% total width, visibly long, depth only a small fraction of tank height. Realistic sand grains, wet gravel, modest coastal greenery. Sandy contour connected across shallows, low artillery blocked by hill and dunes. Bright warm afternoon, pale blue sky and deeply blurred coastal haze.
